headline: Approved consent item for a commercial kitchen home occupation at 865 South Prospect Street; held public hearings on three other projects without final votes.
summary: The Board approved a consent agenda item for a proposed commercial kitchen home occupation at 865 South Prospect Street. It also held public hearings on an accessory dwelling unit at 227 North Champlain St, an addition at 45 Howard Street, and a proposed 16-unit building at 124-126 North Avenue, closing each hearing for later deliberation without recording a final decision. The Board also heard a presentation on a potential bylaw change for administrative review and off-site constructed housing from 802 Homes.
decisions: Approved the consent item for a proposed commercial kitchen home occupation at 865 South Prospect Street, vote 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Geoff Hand: Motioned to approve and adopt staff findings and recommendations, Chase Taylor 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.
